headline: Singapore's Foreign Minister Dr Vivian Balakrishnan will make an official visit to Islamabad on Friday, October 30, at the invitation of Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, the Foreign Office said.

card.desc: Balakrishnan to hold talks with Ishaq Dar on October 30.

caption:
Singapore's Foreign Minister Dr Vivian Balakrishnan will make an official visit to Islamabad on Friday, October 30, at the invitation of Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, Dawn reports. A disaster management MoU between Pakistan's NDMA and Singapore's Civil Defence Force will be exchanged during the visit, Arab News adds.
